\bar z=\frac{\iiint_{\Omega}z\rho_0\,dV}{\iiint_{\Omega}\rho_0\,dV}=\frac{\rho_0\int_0^{2\pi}d\theta\int_0^H r\,dr\int_r^H z\,dz}{\rho_0\int_0^{2\pi}d\theta\int_0^H r\,dr\int_r^H dz}=\frac{\frac{\pi}{4}H^4}{\frac{\pi}{3}H^3}=\frac{3}{4}H.
